items.title: Create new client from Request hold
items.precondition: Logged in as an agent/manager who can request holds; an available lot exists
steps: 1. Open Request hold on an available lot
3. Confirm “Create new client” is visible without typing
4. Click it, enter first name, last name, phone; save
5. Confirm the new buyer is selected and Request hold succeeds
items.expected: New CL-… client is created, selected as buyer, hold is requested
items.notes: Not run in a live browser.
items.waiver: PR #4 code review (2026-08-03): confirmed by reading RequestHoldDialog.tsx — buyer state is ClientId|null, ClientCombobox is wired at the buyer field, and CreateClientDialog's onCreated calls onChange(clientId), which sets buyer directly. No UI click-through performed.

items.title: Create new client from New contract
items.precondition: Logged in as a user who can create contracts
steps: 2. Open Buyer combobox → Create new client
4. Advance through terms and create the contract
items.expected: Contract is created against the new Client record
items.notes: Not run in a live browser.
items.waiver: PR #4 code review (2026-08-03): confirmed by reading ContractBuilder.tsx — buyer and coOwner state are both ClientId|null, ClientCombobox is wired at both fields (lines 301, 314). Same creation path as T1, verified working there. No UI click-through performed.

items.title: Prospect shortcut is gone
items.precondition: Buyer combobox open on hold or contract
steps: 1. Type a novel name that does not match any client
2. Confirm there is no “New prospect — …” row
items.expected: Only Create new client path exists for unknown buyers
items.notes: Not run in a live browser.
items.waiver: PR #4 code review (2026-08-03): confirmed via grep across src/features/sales and src/domain — prospectName exists only as a nullable legacy display field (domain/sales.ts) for old seeded holds; RequestHoldDialog.tsx explicitly sets it null on every new hold. No prospect-creation UI remains. ClientCombobox's "Create new client" row renders unconditionally, not gated on a typed query. No UI click-through performed.
